question: In Hodgkin Lymphoma trials, bucket overall follow-up months into <12, 12–23, or ≥24.
hidden_column: Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Control
gt_sql:
SELECT "NCT", "Trial name", "Follow-up duration for primary endpoint(s) in months | Overall" FROM clinical_trials
WHERE "Cancer type" = 'Hodgkin Lymphoma';
